name: Ouargli
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Read full texts of Biarnay 1908 Etude sur le dialecte berbere de Ouargla, Delheure/Ochoa Grammaire de la teggargrent, and Basset 1893 Zenatia study on archive.org: no accent/stress section in any.

sources.citation: Delheure, Jean. 2019 [1987]. Grammaire de la teggargrent (berbère parlé à Ouargla). Études et Documents Berbères 42: 45-142 (reprint of the 1987 Pères Blancs edition, ed. J.A. Ochoa & O. Ould-Braham; OA at Cairn DOI 10.3917/edb.042.0045; archive.org copy).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Part I 'Phonèmes et notations' treats only the vowel system (a i u + schwa 'appui syllabique') and consonants; no word on accent/stress anywhere in the grammar (only 'intonation de la voix' for direct questions in the syntax part).

sources.citation: Delheure, Jean. 1987. Agerraw n iwalen teggargrent-taṛumit / Dictionnaire ouargli-français. Paris: SELAF (Études ethno-linguistiques Maghreb-Sahara 5).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Introduction on phonemes and notation: 'les voyelles pleines a, i, u, sans longueur pertinente', schwa as syllabic prop; accent is neither marked nor discussed.

sources.citation: Delheure, Jean (1987). Grammaire de la teggargrent: berbère parlé à Ouargla. Pères Blancs.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online
sources.note: No catalog record exists; the grammar gives no placement rule and no statement about the presence or absence of word stress. Note the 1987 Pères Blancs original has different pagination; page numbers here are those of the 2019 EDB 42 reprint held by the project.

sources.citation: Biarnay, Samuel. 1908. Étude sur le dialecte berbère de Ouargla. Paris: Ernest Leroux (Publ. de l'École des Lettres d'Alger).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online; also in print at Harvard (Widener Library, call number 2245.70; Lamont Library (offsite storage), call number Film W 16393; Tozzer Library (offsite storage), call number L.SOC.3.3.5 (37); a Harvard library (offsite storage), call number Film Mas 28511) (also online with a university library login)
sources.harvard_location: Widener Library, call number 2245.70; Lamont Library (offsite storage), call number Film W 16393; Tozzer Library (offsite storage), call number L.SOC.3.3.5 (37); a Harvard library (offsite storage), call number Film Mas 28511
sources.note: 'Phonétique' chapter covers sounds, reinforcements and assimilations; 'accentuer/accentuation' is used only for consonant strengthening (n > mm(ou)); no statement on word accent; texts not accent-marked.

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online; also in print at Harvard (Widener Library (offsite storage), call number 2245.90; Lamont Library (offsite storage), call number Film W 16379; a Harvard library (offsite storage), call number Film Mas 28399)

The listed HathiTrust copy (mdp.39015050616427) could not be reached by automated download with an automated-access block 'Just a moment..' challenge by automated download on both attempts (record page and plaintext page view), so it could not be confirmed full-view by automated download; the same edition was read from the archive.org copy already saved in our check folder by the earlier source-search pass. The footnote points to Basset's Manuel de langue kabyle (1887) as the place where his general phonetic sections (possibly including accent) live, but that describes Kabyl…

sources.citation: Maakni, Nora Chahinez. 2017. Approche linguistique de constructions en Kabyle et en Ouargli en Algérie. Mémoire de Master, Université Kasdi Merbah Ouargla.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Generic paragraph on prosody (theory); nothing on Ouargli word accent.

sources.citation: Souag, Lameen & Marijn van Putten. 2016. The origin of mid vowels in Siwi. Studies in African Linguistics 45: 189-208.
sources.access_detail: read online, no copy kept
sources.note: Cites Ouargla lexical forms from Delheure only; nothing on Ouargli accent.

sources.citation: Chaker, Salem. 2013. « Ouargla [Wargrən < Warglən] : Langue » (notice O36). Encyclopédie berbère 36. DOI 10.4000/encyclopedieberbere.2848.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: 'Phonétique – Phonologie' section (vowel system, k/g palatalisation, s/š confusion, pharyngealised liquids, final ɣ > a, initial-vowel loss) is silent on accent; notes only that Delheure does not signal intonation.

sources.citation: Kossmann, Maarten & Harry Stroomer. 1997. Berber phonology. In Alan S. Kaye (ed.), Phonologies of Asia and Africa, vol. 1, 461-475. Winona Lake: Eisenbrauns.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online (also online with a university library login)
sources.note: Standard overview of Berber phonology with a paragraph on accent; would state what (if anything) is known for Zenatic varieties such as Ouargla/Mzab.
